content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect the expansion modules from [version_no] 8.2 to a [product_name] device from [version_no] 8.3?
Any expansion module with [article_no] in the last segment of its article number can be used with all [version_no] 0BA8 units ([version_no] 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, and 8.3).

analysis.insight_summary: Users want clarity about compatibility between [product_name] expansion modules from [version_no] 8.2 and main units from [version_no] 8.3, referencing modules with [article_no] identifiers.
